v5.1.0

  • Add --last-failed to run only failed tests  -  by @​sheremet-va in vitest-dev/vitest#11558 (82f63)
  • Support Temporal.Instant and Temporal.ZonedDateTime in vi.setSystemTime()  -  by @​Prajwal2246, Prajwal2246, Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context), @​hi-ogawa and Codex (GPT-6) in vitest-dev/vitest#11321 (f150f)

body:
Updates the requirements on [psycopg[pool]](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg) to permit the latest version.
Changelog

Sourced from psycopg[pool]'s changelog.

.. currentmodule:: psycopg

.. index:: single: Release notes single: News

psycopg release notes

Current release

Psycopg 3.3.9 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

  • Use the C implementation of the wait functions on Windows too. It was disabled because of an excessive CPU usage, fixed in Psycopg 3.2.11 (:ticket:[#645](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/645)).
  • Fix binary dumping of !Int4Range and other typed ranges and multiranges (:ticket:[#1157](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1157)).
  • Fix dumping of Decimal 0 with large exponent (part of :ticket:[#1414](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1414)).
  • Close the connection if the query cancellation following a Ctrl-C or a task cancellation is interrupted again, instead of leaving it stuck in ACTIVE state (:ticket:[#1435](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1435)).
  • Limit the memory used by :sql:COPY FROM if the server consumes data slower than it is produced. Add a !flush_threshold parameter to ~copy.LibpqWriter to tune it (:ticket:[#1437](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1437)).
  • Don't wait on the event loop when the socket is already writable, which made pipeline mode, ~AsyncCursor.executemany() and ~AsyncCopy.write() on async connections several times slower than on sync ones (:ticket:[#1468](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1468)).
  • Fix client-side quoting of negative zero floats and decimals, which could produce a -- SQL comment (:ticket:[#1480](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1480)).
  • Raise DataError instead of !ValueError registering a composite whose name or attributes are not valid namedtuple names, for instance Python keywords (:ticket:[#1482](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1482)).
  • Speed up the C implementation of the sync wait function, in particular when the connection doesn't need to wait, for instance at every ~Copy.write() (:ticket:[#1484](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1484)).
  • Don't replace the exception raised in a :sql:COPY block, for instance an interruption, with an error terminating the operation (:ticket:[#1486](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1486)).
  • Fix ~copy.QueuedLibpqWriter hanging forever, instead of raising the error, if sending data to the server fails while its queue is full (:ticket:[#1489](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1489)).
  • Performance improvements to lists dumping (:tickets:[#1490](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1490), [#1491](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1491)).
  • 2.5x faster UUID loading in the C implementation (:ticket:[#1494](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1494)).
  • Reduce the size of the binary packages by about 15 to 40%, depending on the platform.

... (truncated)

Bumps the python-dependencies group with 6 updates: | Package | From | To | | --- | --- | --- | | [click](https://github.com/pallets/click) | `8.5.0` | `8.5.1` | | [pydantic-ai-slim[logfire,openai]](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai) | `2.66.0` | `2.68.0` | | [psycopg-binary](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg) | `3.3.8` | `3.3.9` | | [zensical](https://github.com/zensical/zensical) | `0.1.0` | `0.1.1` | | [pytest-asyncio](https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest-asyncio) | `1.4.1.post1` | `1.5.0` | | [ruff](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff) | `0.17.4` | `0.17.5` | Updates `click` from 8.5.0 to 8.5.1
Release notes

Sourced from click's releases.

8.5.1

This is the Click 8.5.1 fix release, which fixes bugs but does not otherwise change behavior and should not result in breaking changes compared to the latest feature release.

PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/click/8.5.1/ Changes: https://click.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-8-5-1 Milestone: https://github.com/pallets/click/milestone/66

  • Fix copy.deepcopy() and pickle on a Parameter, Option or Command. #3805
  • A KeyboardInterrupt arriving while Command.main() reports an abort or an error, or while it exits, no longer escapes as an unhandled traceback. The command still exits with the intended code; only the message may be lost. #3802
  • Add Option.get_help_spec(), which returns the option's left help column even when the option is hidden. Option.get_help_record() still returns None for hidden options, so help screens are unchanged. #3821
  • The Positional arguments help section lists every argument of the command, not only the documented ones. An argument with no help gets an empty description, the same way an option with no help does. #3860
  • Argument.get_help_record() always returns a tuple. It used to return None for an argument with no help. #3860
  • Document which types are inferred from default, and what an unrecognized type callable does to a command-line value. #3036 #3808
  • path_type narrows the converted value's type for convert and prompt. #3822 #3858
  • Parameter accepts a new help argument, and Option and Argument inherit it. Parameter.to_info_dict() now reports help for every kind of parameter. #3861
  • A command's short help no longer stops at an abbreviation such as vs. or e.g. inside the first sentence. A period ends the sentence only when it closes the text or the next word does not start in lowercase. #3865
  • With show_envvar=True, an option's error message now prints all variables of an envvar sequence instead of the repr of the sequence. #3884
  • An empty envvar, such as [] or "", shows the same help and error message as no envvar when show_envvar=True. The help screen used to show [env var: ]. #3884
  • Align command's deprecated help text to options and arguments: do not translate the command's own help text, only the (DEPRECATED) label. #3901
Changelog

Sourced from click's changelog.

Version 8.5.1

Released 2026-11-09

  • Fix copy.deepcopy() and pickle on a Parameter, Option or Command. {pr}3805
  • A KeyboardInterrupt arriving while Command.main() reports an abort or an error, or while it exits, no longer escapes as an unhandled traceback. The command still exits with the intended code; only the message may be lost. {issue}3802
  • Add {meth}Option.get_help_spec, which returns the option's left help column even when the option is hidden. {meth}Option.get_help_record still returns None for hidden options, so help screens are unchanged. {pr}3821
  • The Positional arguments help section lists every argument of the command, not only the documented ones. An argument with no help gets an empty description, the same way an option with no help does. {pr}3860
  • {meth}Argument.get_help_record always returns a tuple. It used to return None for an argument with no help. {pr}3860
  • Document which types are inferred from default, and what an unrecognized type callable does to a command-line value. {issue}3036 {pr}3808
  • path_type narrows the converted value's type for convert and prompt. {issue}3822 {pr}3858
  • {class}Parameter accepts a new help argument and {class}Option and {class}Argument inherits it. {meth}Parameter.to_info_dict now reports help for every kind of parameter. {pr}3861
  • A command's short help no longer stops at an abbreviation such as vs. or e.g. inside the first sentence. A period ends the sentence only when it closes the text or the next word does not start in lowercase. {pr}3865
  • With show_envvar=True, an option's error message now prints all variables of an envvar sequence instead of the repr of the sequence. {pr}3884
  • An empty envvar, such as [] or "", shows the same help and error message as no envvar when show_envvar=True. The help screen used to show [env var: ]. {pr}3884
  • Align command's deprecated help text to options and arguments: do not translate the command's own help text, only the (DEPRECATED) label. {pr}3901

Changelog

Sourced from psycopg-binary's changelog.

.. currentmodule:: psycopg

.. index:: single: Release notes single: News

psycopg release notes

Current release

Psycopg 3.3.9 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

  • Use the C implementation of the wait functions on Windows too. It was disabled because of an excessive CPU usage, fixed in Psycopg 3.2.11 (:ticket:[#645](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/645)).
  • Fix binary dumping of !Int4Range and other typed ranges and multiranges (:ticket:[#1157](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1157)).
  • Fix dumping of Decimal 0 with large exponent (part of :ticket:[#1414](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1414)).
  • Close the connection if the query cancellation following a Ctrl-C or a task cancellation is interrupted again, instead of leaving it stuck in ACTIVE state (:ticket:[#1435](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1435)).
  • Limit the memory used by :sql:COPY FROM if the server consumes data slower than it is produced. Add a !flush_threshold parameter to ~copy.LibpqWriter to tune it (:ticket:[#1437](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1437)).
  • Don't wait on the event loop when the socket is already writable, which made pipeline mode, ~AsyncCursor.executemany() and ~AsyncCopy.write() on async connections several times slower than on sync ones (:ticket:[#1468](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1468)).
  • Fix client-side quoting of negative zero floats and decimals, which could produce a -- SQL comment (:ticket:[#1480](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1480)).
  • Raise DataError instead of !ValueError registering a composite whose name or attributes are not valid namedtuple names, for instance Python keywords (:ticket:[#1482](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1482)).
  • Speed up the C implementation of the sync wait function, in particular when the connection doesn't need to wait, for instance at every ~Copy.write() (:ticket:[#1484](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1484)).
  • Don't replace the exception raised in a :sql:COPY block, for instance an interruption, with an error terminating the operation (:ticket:[#1486](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1486)).
  • Fix ~copy.QueuedLibpqWriter hanging forever, instead of raising the error, if sending data to the server fails while its queue is full (:ticket:[#1489](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1489)).
  • Performance improvements to lists dumping (:tickets:[#1490](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1490), [#1491](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1491)).
  • 2.5x faster UUID loading in the C implementation (:ticket:[#1494](https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg/issues/1494)).
  • Reduce the size of the binary packages by about 15 to 40%, depending on the platform.

title: Configurable model binding for Reach and an operator opt-in for Portal dispatch
body:
## Change and scope

Two hardcoded bindings stop an operator from using a model they already run or pay for. This PR lets each be configured, leaves the defaults unchanged, and keeps the existing refusals for anyone who doesn't opt in.

### 1. Opt one Portal into dispatch (`allow_dispatch`)

Every Portal grant is refused until the egress-admission gate exists, so a declared remote endpoint can't answer even when its operator intends it to.

- New Portal rune field `allow_dispatch` (default `false`, requires `probe = true`). An opted-in Portal is granted like any warm capability once its probe lists the declared model; every other Portal is refused exactly as before (`portal egress admission is not configured`).
- The opted-in probe authenticates with the Portal's own secret, because a credentialed gateway answers an anonymous `/models` with 401. A missing secret leaves the capability COLD with a reason naming the secret. Un-opted Portals keep the unauthenticated probe.
- Among equally ready candidates a local Soulstone still outranks a Portal.
- Archive, semantic, Scout and Creation workflows keep their Soulstone-only checks.

This is an operator's explicit choice, not the egress gate from State of Work: none of the privatization, secure-mode, local-before-paid or spend gates exist, and the Portal doc says so next to the flag.

### 2. Reach operator conversation: any model and endpoint

The conversation profile was frozen to `Qwen3.8-27B` on `night-qwen38` at the literal `http://127.0.0.1:28000`, so any other model needed a local adapter that impersonated that name.

- `animator_id` and `model_id` become closed, validated strings defaulting to the previous values. Existing profiles keep their digest (the legacy-digest test is unchanged and passes).
- `--model-endpoint` admits a loopback HTTP IP literal with any explicit port (as before), or any HTTPS endpoint with an optional path prefix. Credentials, queries, fragments, trailing slashes and plain remote HTTP are refused. `--model-transport podman` stays loopback-only.
- `--model-api-key-file` reads one bearer credential from a private file; it never appears in argv.
- A remote endpoint has no standard `/health`, so its `/v1/models` inventory is the probe. A catalogue larger than the 32-entry wire bound reports only the selected model to the worker.
- A completion may report the bare model a gateway reached for a routed id (`vendor/model` → `model`). That exact suffix is the only accepted alias; any other model is still refused, on both the host broker and the worker side.
- `reach_probe.py` accepts the same endpoint and credential options.

## Verification

- New tests: Portal opt-in requires probe, authenticated probe and grant, unauthenticated probe for un-opted Portals, missing secret → COLD (`test_portals.py`); endpoint admission and refusal cases, remote gateway probe/inventory/routed-model flow with bearer auth, different-model refusal, credential validation (`cli/test_reach_operator_model.py`); configurable binding with unchanged legacy digest, routed-suffix matching, identifier validation (`compositions/test_reach_operator_model.py`).
- `pytest tests/unit/interface tests/unit/cli tests/unit/compositions tests/unit/domain/animation tests/unit/domain/cortex` against this branch and against unmodified `dev`, both with `--basetemp` outside any Git checkout: identical failure set (22 failed in both, environment-dependent mount/transmute and Reach portability/research-image suites), 39 more passing here. `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` clean on changed files.
- Not run in the OCI test image.
- Live, on a rootless Podman 6.1.4 host:
  - Portal: an `allow_dispatch` Portal pointed at a credentialed OpenAI-compatible gateway registered WARM and answered a real Bridge message.
  - Reach: images built from this branch (plus #149's Podman fixes, needed to build on Podman at all), then `reach_probe.py --model-transport http --model-endpoint https://<gateway> --model-api-key-file <file>` with a routed `vendor/model` id passed: probe and generation succeeded against the remote endpoint with no local adapter.

## Documentation and delivery claims

- `docs/sepulcher/animator/portal.md`: documents `allow_dispatch` and what it does not provide.
- `docs/compositions/reach/operator.md`: documents the configurable binding, the endpoint rules, the credential file, and that the remote road sends conversation, persona and context to that provider.

## Author review

- [x] I reviewed the full diff, including any AI-assisted changes, and can explain the submitted code and its verification.
- [ ] I identified any reused upstream material and checked its provenance, changes, license obligations and shipped notices under the [reuse procedure](https://github.com/hexanomicon/lychd/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reuse-upstream-material), or confirmed that this change incorporates none.
